thread.title: Q2 2019 Earnings Forecast for Apple Inc. Issued By Piper Jaffray Companies (AAPL)

author: Alphonse Anthony
title: Q2 2019 Earnings Forecast for Apple Inc. Issued By Piper Jaffray Companies (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies boosted their Q2 2019 earnings per share estimates for Apple in a research note issued to investors on Monday, October 1st. Piper Jaffray Companies analyst M. Olson now forecasts that the iPhone maker will post earnings per share of $3.11 for the quarter, up from their prior estimate of $3.08. Piper Jaffray Companies has a “Overweight” rating and a $250.00 price objective on the stock. Piper Jaffray Companies also issued estimates for Apple’s Q3 2019 earnings at $2.51 EPS, Q4 2019 earnings at $3.05 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $13.57 EPS and FY2020 earnings at $14.65 EPS. A number of other analysts have also commented on AAPL. Royal Bank of Canada raised their price target on Apple from $203.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock an “outperform” rating in a research note on Tuesday, June 5th. Goldman Sachs Group reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $164.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, June 5th. UBS Group set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Thursday, June 7th. Argus raised their price target on Apple from $210.00 to $225.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, June 8th. Finally, BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Friday, June 8th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $220.78.
Shares of AAPL stock opened at $229.28 on Tuesday. Apple has a 52 week low of $150.24 and a 52 week high of $230.00. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a P/E ratio of 24.89, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $1.67 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis.

Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
